title: Connection Scorecard Across Rituals
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=relationship:ritual
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(connection_score) as avg_connection_score dc(ritual_type) as ritual_variety by _time
| sort - _time
description: Examines connection score across relationship rituals.
value: A combined scorecard keeps the relationship dashboard honest without reducing everything to one metric forever.
implementation: Send connection score across relationship rituals events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of connection score across relationship rituals, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It produces what is happening with connection score across relationship rituals, so odd changes stand out quickly.
